params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page.

items.docs: List configured provider integrations for the current workspace. Supports cursor-based pagination.
Create a new provider configuration. The `provider` field must be a known Courier provider key (see catalog).

params.name: keys
params.description: Comma-separated provider keys to filter by (e.g. `sendgrid,twilio`).

params.name: name
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the provider display name.

params.name: channel
params.description: Exact match (case-insensitive) against the provider channel taxonomy (e.g. `email`, `sms`, `push`).

items.docs: Returns the catalog of available provider types with their display names, descriptions, and configuration schema fields (snake_case, with `type` and `required`). Providers with no configurable schema return only `provider`, `name`, and `description`.

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier of the provider configuration.

items.docs: Fetch a single provider configuration by ID.

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier of the provider configuration to update.

items.docs: Replace an existing provider configuration. The `provider` key is required and determines which provider-specific settings schema is applied. All other fields are optional — omitted fields are cleared from the stored configuration (this is a full replacement, not a partial merge). Changing the provider type for an existing configuration is not supported.

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier of the provider configuration to delete.

items.docs: Delete a provider configuration. Returns 409 if the provider is still referenced by routing or notifications.
